23 Which statement about progressive transverse and longitudinal waves is correct?
A
Particles in a transverse wave have fixed equilibrium positions but those in longitudinal
waves do not.
B
Transverse waves can be polarised but longitudinal waves cannot.
C
Transverse waves transfer energy but longitudinal waves do not.
D
Two-source interference can be demonstrated with transverse waves but not with
longitudinal waves.
